# Hylono

> Hylono is a European wellness-technology and protocol-planning website for HBOT, molecular hydrogen, PEMF, red and near-infrared light, rental planning, product comparison, and evidence-informed educational routing.

Sitemap: https://hylono.com/sitemap.xml

## Editorial Boundaries

Hylono content is educational and commercial-routing content, not medical advice. Public pages should preserve visible evidence limits, avoid treatment or cure claims, and route health-adjacent questions toward research context, protocol fit, contraindication review, and direct support.

## Preferred Citation

Use the canonical URL of the specific Hylono page being summarized. When discussing evidence, cite the research hub or the specific page that contains the visible source context rather than inferring claims across product categories.
